Diljit Dosanjh Reschedules Delhi Concert Ahead of 1984 Riots Anniversary

Singer Diljit Dosanjh has rescheduled his Delhi concert, moving it forward from its original date to avoid the anniversary of the 1984 anti-Sikh riots. Rajya Sabha MP Vikramjit Singh Sahney thanked Dosanjh for this decision, calling him the "True Son Of Punjab."
